protocol: cold full ADP_multi_index.fit in isolated process; same synthetic data/fit seed per pair; float64; SVD rank=2; HYBRID max_steps=5,tol=1e-6
data_generator: X~N(0,I); true basis is QR of independent Gaussian d-by-m matrix; Y=sum(sin(XB)+0.25*(XB)^2)+0.2*N(0,1). Data seed equals pair seed.
fit_configuration: ADP_Config(seed=data_seed+1000,N_loc=15,lambda_penalty=0.05,h_min=0.35,a=sqrt(2),outer_steps=3,select_step=best,batch_size=32,index_init=local,estimator=new,direction_mode=auto,multi_tensor=orthogonal,redraw_directions=true,training_set=all); kernel is Epanechnikov max(1-u^2,0) on scaled anisotropic distance; N_J/N_phi/N_lin by case. Center selection is seeded without replacement; local initializer is data-driven.
solver_configuration: SVD rank=2, inner_tol=1e-6, inner_maxiter=20, default LSMR v cap; HYBRID max_steps=5,tol=1e-6, strict hybrid_inner_rtol=None and default dense limits. Both run CPU float64.
objective_note: SVD fixed-g rank-r objective and HYBRID HPAO correction-penalty objective differ; numeric lambda_penalty is shared but objectives are not equivalent.
timing_method: time.perf_counter around fit only; no warm-up; isolated fresh subprocess per fit; BLAS/OpenMP threads fixed to one.
memory_method: resource.ru_maxrss in KiB includes interpreter/import baseline; tracemalloc peak covers Python-tracked allocations during fit and excludes many native allocations.
quality_metric: ||B_est B_est.T - B_true B_true.T||_F / sqrt(2m), smaller is better; truth is used only for post-fit evaluation.
pilot_note: The sibling experiments/svd_vs_hybrid_2026-09-28 folder preserves 12 invalid pre-fit attempts where N_J was below ceil(n/N_loc); these are excluded. This v2 run used valid N_J and all 12 fits completed.
